tests.name: provider gate and lawful acquisition
tests.expected: Without every source pointer, eligibility, prerequisites, acquisition, repertoire, cost and availability field, remain held; with a valid witness, record the separately authorized inserted-turn event without inventing source facts.

The inserted interval creates no extra 6d6 opportunity, regular-END save, recharge tick, Ready reset or duration extension.

tests.expected: Record whether source permits a grant to an Unconscious recipient. Do not let an incapacitated recipient activate an ability. The inserted interval creates no extra 4d10 opportunity, regular-END save, recharge tick, Ready reset or duration extension.

tests.name: Attached recipient phase non-duplication
tests.expected: Preserve the actual companion/controller link and one attached START/END checkpoint; an inserted turn never creates another attached phase or exposure.
